Name: PCBs
Purpose: These will be the PCBs for all of my modules!

Name: USB-231-ARY
Purpose: These will be the USB-A output ports for my USB-A output module!

Name: KH-TYPE-C-CY-14P
Purpose: This will be the USB port on my USB-C modules which can be used as both an input from the host for the hub or as an output!

Name: MF1/4W-5.1KΩ±1% T
Purpose: This will be the resistor that will pull the CC pins on the USB-C module to ground to avoid conflicts in connecting devices!

Name: AM90
Purpose: This will be the male USB port that will plug into the host USB port!

Name: NSR0320MW2T1G
Purpose: This will be the diode that will prevent current backflow back into the USB port the hub is connected to!

Name: SL2.1A
Purpose: This will be the chip that converts 1 USB input into 4 outputs!

Name: CL10A106KP8NNNC
Purpose: These will be the capacitors that will keep the voltage stable for my USB hub!
